title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy connect-src allows plaintext HTTP origins
description: The policy allowed a plaintext connection to a named origin. Unlike a missing header, this is an explicit permission: the application told the browser that cleartext data channels are acceptable. The finding is the permission, not a demonstrated interception.
applicability: HTML responses that carry a Content-Security-Policy.
risk: Credentials and response data readable on the path; MEDIUM severity.
